pages.title: Melody Game
pages.text: Listen and Follow along. A game of Simon! You can press on the notes to hear what instrument they play beforehand!

pages.title: Blank Optical Disc
pages.text: A Blank Optical Disc needs to be inserted into the Sequencer to start the melody sequence.

pages.title: Audio Synchronized Disc
pages.text: An Audio Synchronized Disc is given for succesfully completing the game.
